description: Implementation of E2 subscription management class handling subscription setup, deletion, start, stop, and action support for RAN functions within a 5G network context.

classes.name: e2_subscription_manager_impl
classes.description: Class managing E2 subscriptions, including setup, deletion, and action handling for RAN functions.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all active subscriptions and clears the subscription list.

methods.name: handle_subscription_setup
methods.description: Handles setup requests for new subscriptions, including validation and response generation.

methods.name: handle_subscription_delete
methods.description: Handles deletion requests for existing subscriptions.

methods.name: start_subscription
methods.description: Initiates a subscription, launching indication procedures.

methods.name: stop_subscription
methods.description: Stops an active subscription and cleans up resources.

methods.name: action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is supported for a given RAN function and request.

methods.name: get_subscription_result
methods.description: Generates the result of a subscription request, indicating success and supported actions.

methods.name: add_e2sm_service
methods.description: Adds an E2SM service interface to the internal list.

methods.name: get_e2sm_interface
methods.description: Retrieves an E2SM interface by its OID.

methods.name: add_ran_function_oid
methods.description: Associates a RAN function ID with an E2SM OID.
